features.label: Bergamot translation engine (WASM)

patches.author: Alex Hochheiden
patches.subject: Add the annotations future import to the modules FA102 flags

features.summary: The Bergamot Translator code now postpones evaluating type annotations in modules flagged by the project’s lint rules. This is a code-maintenance change, with no expected change to how translations appear or work.

features.label: Translations engine & about:translations

patches.author: jsimplicio
patches.subject: Message bar spec update for Nova

features.summary: The translation message bar’s specification has been updated for Nova, aligning its expected behavior with the latest design. This keeps the translation prompt consistent with the current interface guidance.

features.label: Translations engine docs

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: Fix the Translations overview table of contents

features.summary: The Translations overview documentation now has a corrected table of contents, making it easier to find the section you need. This is a documentation-only change; Firefox’s translation features are unchanged.

features.label: Translations panels

patches.author: Erik Nordin
patches.subject: Distinguish target-language fluent strings in Full-Page Translations

features.summary: Full-Page Translations now distinguishes Fluent strings for the target language. Fluent is the format Firefox uses for localized interface text, and the distinction helps make those strings easier to recognize.

features.label: Translations UI tests

patches.author: Florian Quèze
patches.subject: Remove test.wait300msAfterTabSwitch from browser/ tests that already pass without it.

patches.author: Erik Nordin
patches.subject: Release SelectTranslations ports after each request

patches.author: Erik Nordin
patches.subject: Add Full-Page TranslationsEngine lifetime regression coverage

features.summary: Translation UI tests now avoid unnecessary pauses after tab switches, release their SelectTranslations communication ports after each request, and check that the full-page translation engine stays alive for the right duration. These changes make the tests more focused on real behavior and help catch resource-lifetime problems; they do not alter the translation interface.

features.label: Translations engine & about:translations

patches.author: jsimplicio
patches.subject: Message bar spec update for Nova

features.summary: The translation message bar’s specification was updated for Nova, and the clear button on about:translations was aligned correctly. Together, these changes bring the translation interface into line with current design guidance and polish a small layout detail.

features.label: Translations engine tests

patches.author: Erik Nordin
patches.subject: Add about:translations engine lifetime regression coverage

features.summary: The about:translations tests now cover how long the translation engine remains active, and its communication ports are managed more carefully. This helps catch and prevent problems where translation resources are kept around longer than needed.
